findings.message: Unsupported: Same gap: LifeOf reads one player's life and no amount takes the greatest life among the other players, so "more life than each other player" has no condition.

Unsupported: Same gap: no condition says a player controls strictly more lands than every other player. CountOf reads one filter for one controller and no amount takes the maximum over the other players.

Unsupported: No condition asks whether one player's count is strictly greater than every other player's. Compare takes two amounts and there is no amount for "the greatest cards in hand among the other players"; PlayerWithMostOf names a player and no condition compares a player against the triggering player, and it would admit a tie besides.
